activity.notes: ATLAS uses 211 as the map-level start of the Liu Bei/Shu Han territorial interval, consistent with Liu Bei and Guan Yu already in Production; Zhao Yun's service to Liu Bei began earlier. The Sanguozhi records his participation in the Yi Province campaign, continued senior military service under Shu Han, and death in 229.
